NOVU_SECRET_KEY.description: Novu says using it in client-side code both causes cross-origin errors and exposes the secret key, which is a rare case of a provider naming the accident before the risk.

NOVU_APPLICATION_IDENTIFIER.description: The Inbox component takes it in the browser, so a working install publishes it. Novu never says so, and unlike Sinch or OneSignal it draws no line, so this registry does not draw one for it.
